description:
Are you ready to create the coolest and most urban looks? Design unique and comfortable outfits that will make your girls shine in their everyday life. Explore a wide variety of clothes, hairstyles and accessories to mix and match in original ways. Unleash your creativity and become the most trendsetting stylist on the street!

Featured Features:

-Infinite combinations: Create unique urban styles by combining clothes, hairstyles and accessories - the possibilities are endless!
-Photo mode: Save your favourite looks with photo mode and share them with your friends.
-For all styles: Perfect for fashion experts or beginners.
-Customise hairstyles and accessories: Change hair colour and style and add accessories to make each look even more unique.

Start styling your most casual and urban looks right now and show off your streetstyle!
name: Doll Style: Underground Design and Dress
intro: Create unique styles for your girls with casual urban looks! Combine clothes, hairstyles and accessories to shine on the streets.
